# gcore_cdn_logs_uploader_target (Resource)

Logs uploader targets define destinations for CDN log delivery, such as S3 buckets or SFTP servers, with associated authentication and configuration settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gcore_cdn_logs_uploader_target" "example_cdn_logs_uploader_target" {
  config = {
    access_key_id = "access_key_id"
    bucket_name = "bucket_name"
    directory = "directory"
    endpoint = "endpoint"
    region = "region"
    secret_access_key = "secret_access_key"
    use_path_style = true
  }
  storage_type = "s3_gcore"
  description = "description"
  name = "name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Attributes) Config for specific storage type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `storage_type` (String) Type of storage for logs.
Available values: "s3_gcore", "s3_amazon", "s3_oss", "s3_other", "s3_v1", "ftp", "sftp", "http", "azure_blob", "sls".

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the target.
- `name` (String) Name of the target.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (Number) Client that owns the target.
- `created` (String) Time when logs uploader target was created.
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
